scope: Concise milestones and evidence boundaries; not a transcript or complete event log.

milestones.summary: Read-only hardware inventory and offline ACPI/display/component analysis were recorded. Raw captures remain private and are not part of this copy.
milestones.limitation: The historical verification document describes its own earlier stage; it is not a current system-status report.

milestones.summary: Tahoe 26.6.2 / 25G83 was installed and reached the desktop. Earlier Recovery/USB troubleshooting notes are retained as historical documentation.
milestones.limitation: The original private runtime captures and orchestration timeline were deliberately excluded.

milestones.summary: Four accelerated Tiger Lake boots panicked after approximately 252–340 seconds. Exact first corrupter and causal component remain unknown.
milestones.limitation: Detailed panic captures are private and were not copied; this public index does not independently verify them.

milestones.summary: One software-display control preserved basic display and ran for approximately 62 minutes 35 seconds without a user-reported freeze; a shutdown sequence appeared in the capture.
milestones.limitation: One non-matched run does not establish causation, component attribution, or long-term stability; final physical power-off was not independently observed.

privacy_note: Personal paths, network endpoints, serial/SMBIOS identities, credentials, private keys, and raw logs are intentionally not included. A missing private artifact is not a verified result.
